title: Rabbi David Tawil: Understanding the Amida- "Tishkone"

chapters.title: Introduction to the Amidah and Yerushalayim
Yerushalayim in the Torah and Navi
The Present Tense of Building Yerushalayim

summary: Rabbi Tawil explores the significance of Yerushalayim and the throne of David within the Amidah, noting that while the city is central to Jewish prayer, it is not mentioned in the Torah. He discusses the historical connection of the Jewish people to the land, the tension between religious and secular contributions to the state of Israel, and the importance of maintaining a focus on Yerushalayim in daily life.
questions: Why is Yerushalayim not mentioned in the Torah?
Why do we pray in the direction of Yerushalayim?
What is the historical significance of the Ramban's arrival in Israel?
How does the Amidah reflect the importance of Yerushalayim to the Jewish people?
What is the meaning of the word Tzion?
